About us

BSCS is Bocconi's student society dedicated to commodities, bringing together students interested in the energy, metals, agriculture, and shipping industries. The association combines research into commodity markets and global supply chains with practical exposure to physical trading, derivatives, portfolio management, and quantitative analysis, while also exploring sustainability and ESG issues across the sector.

What we do

Market researchEnergy, Mining & Metals, Agriculture, Shipping & Logistics, Physical Trading and ESG.
Investments & analyticsEquities, Derivatives and Quantitative research.
Events & industry connectionsIndustry conversations, collaboration and professional development opportunities.
OperationsRecruitment, media, events, outreach and corporate relations.
